newsitem.title: USA: DeVry stake raised by New York investor.
newsitem.headline: DeVry stake raised by New York investor.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Wednesday he raised his stake in DeVry Inc to 6.4 percent, or 1,067,800 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said the most recent transactions made by firms under his control include 177,100 shares acquired between December 3 and December 17 at prices ranging from $37.25 to $43.50 each.
Baron and his companies hold the stake in DeVry, a Oakbrook Terrace, Ill.,-based degree-granting school, for investment purposes.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
